recipes.title: My recipes
recipes.emptyDescription: Add your first recipe and start building your own cookbook.

form.title: Title
form.descriptionPlaceholder: A short description of the recipe...
form.ingredientsPlaceholder:
One ingredient per line:
500 g potatoes
4 eggs
form.stepsPlaceholder: One step per paragraph. Leave a blank line between steps.
form.tipsPlaceholder: Tricks and hints to get it right...
form.draftRestored: We kept what you were writing.
form.photoPermission: I need permission to use the camera or your photos.
form.photoError: The photo could not be saved.

detail.keepAwakeHint: While you cook, so it does not dim on you.

delete.title: Move to the trash?
delete.description: You can restore it from the trash.

search.noTags: You have not used any tags yet.

database.error: The database could not be prepared

backup.title: Backup
backup.exportDescription: Save every recipe to a JSON file (schema.org). It works as a backup, and other recipe apps can read it.
backup.exportEmpty: There are no recipes to export yet.
backup.exportError: The file could not be created.
backup.importDescription: Add the recipes in a JSON file exported from Saporium or another app. It never overwrites what you already have.
backup.importedNone: The file held no recipes that could be imported.
backup.importInvalid: That file is not valid JSON.
backup.importError: The file could not be read.

import.title: Import from a website
import.description: Paste the address of a recipe and we bring it in filled out for you to review. Nothing is saved until you save it.
import.fromForm: Is the recipe on a website? Import it

errors.invalidUrl: That address does not look valid.
errors.insecure: Only https addresses can be imported.
errors.timeout: The site took too long to answer.
errors.unreachable: That site could not be reached.
errors.unsupported: I could not find a recipe on that page.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted recipes stay here until you remove them for good.
trash.deleteForeverDescription: "{{title}}" will be gone for good. This cannot be undone.

ai.title: AI (optional)
ai.description: Saporium works fully without AI. If you want it, you bring your own provider key and your phone talks to them directly.
ai.removeDescription: It will be deleted from the device keychain. You can paste it again whenever you want.
ai.privacy: The key is stored in the device keychain. It never enters the database or a backup, and it never leaves your phone except towards your provider.

errors.unauthorized: The provider does not accept that key.
errors.rateLimited: Your provider is rate limiting you. Try again in a while.
errors.unreachable: The provider could not be reached.
errors.timeout: The provider took too long to answer.
errors.badResponse: The provider answered something I cannot read.

paste.title: Paste a recipe
paste.fromForm: Got it written down somewhere? Paste it
paste.description: Paste the text as it is: a message, a slice of a blog, some notes. We tidy it up and bring it to the form for you to review.
paste.cost: This uses your key, so your provider account pays for it.
paste.needsKey: This needs an AI key, and you have not set one up yet.

errors.notARecipe: I could not find a recipe in that text.

scan.title: Photo of a recipe
scan.fromForm: Is it in a book? Take a photo
scan.description: Photograph the page or pick photos from your library. We read them and bring the recipe to the form for you to review.
scan.cost: This uses your key, so your provider account pays for it. Photos are shrunk before they are sent.
scan.needsKey: This needs an AI key, and you have not set one up yet.

errors.notARecipe: I could not read a recipe in those photos.
errors.unreadable: The photo could not be prepared.
